[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has enumerated user accounts and group memberships using `net user` and `net group`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)    

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) also leveraged the legitimate tool AD Explorer to query Active Directory.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)
